name: Million Dollar Extreme
overview:
MDE is Million Dollar Extreme.

MDE is Sam Hyde, Nick Rochefort, and Charles Carroll. We are three regular XBox LIVE-playing dumbass fucksticks just like you, but we think that the "culture" you are consuming is pathetic in profound ways that we could fill an entire book talking about. We won't make you read the book but if you don't stop watching CollegeHumor and start watching us, we are going to find you and kill you.

MDE is a lawless biker gang of funny-boys united by their burning hatred of consumerism who live to write and film mind-fuck wisdom bombs that slice up and dismember the belief systems of 9-5 Wal-Mart drones like tactical bayonets mounted on the AK-47 of insanity.

MDE is the most widely used finishing attack in the Dragon Ball series, and is Goku's signature attack.

MDE is a homeless man shitting in a parking lot and using it to write biblical quotes on the windshields of brand new Scion tC's.
